description: Client-side script managing UI interactions such as tab switching, sidebar toggling, content height checking, page detection, typing effects, and Mermaid diagram fullscreen functionality for a documentation website.

methods.name: showTab
methods.description: Activates a specific tab and its content, updating classes and triggering content height check.

methods.name: applyFlags
methods.description: Sets page detection flags based on URL path, updating body classes for homepage or main section.

methods.name: showTabs
methods.description: Displays a specific entertainment or connectivity tab and updates button states.

methods.name: typeOnce
methods.description: Animates typing effect on specified element, optionally with custom speed and delay.

methods.name: hasTOC
methods.description: Checks if the secondary table of contents sidebar has content.

methods.name: setupSidebarToggle
methods.description: Configures toggle button for sidebars, managing collapse state and local storage.

methods.name: isDesktop
methods.description: Determines if current viewport matches desktop size.
